author: Puysegur
body: I've made a map but it uses blocks from 1.8, I've been waiting to release it. I don't want to change anything about it because I feel the new blocks are quite essential to the look of it. Are there any updates as to when new blocks will work? Have I got this whole thing wrong and you CAN actually use the new blocks? I'm hoping its soon, you can probably expect that I'm quite excited about the map
